description: Election Commission - Orders relevant to Public Service Officers,  in addition to Gaz. Ex. No. 2141/52  (for Presidential Election)
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of orders issued by the Election Commission regarding election-related matters, specifically addressing the investigation of violations concerning the misuse of government property in connection with elections. It outlines procedures for public officers to provide information and documents to the Election Commission, defines government institutions and public officers in the context of these orders, and rescinds a previous gazette on this matter. The content is directly related to electoral processes and commission decisions, fitting clearly within the Elections category (Type 7).
